title: 第7章 愈千伤得顿悟第8章 入内门择灵司
content_zh:
陆玄没有着急走出云亭，实验自己腾云驾雾的飞行之能，而是沉下心神，感受炁海。
他所历之大醮，如此艰难，需要超绝炁感，但相应的，也会有玄妙之能力。
“浊气生于污秽之地，肉眼可见，随意布置一法坛，祈动地力，就可采集。”
“杂炁难度稍稍高上一些，但只要能寻找灵炁交汇之地，亦是容易。”
“清炁，才是真正修行的开始，炁清而纯，采之周身通灵，往后采气修行无有阻碍，且稍稍有几分神异。”
“如【松间炁】，采之御风之能较寻常修士更胜一筹，且周身自带松香……”
“【涧流炁】御水稍强，可无需术法，凝炁成水……”
“但说到底，依旧是天地肉眼可见之炁，稍有几分自然之灵罢了。”
“但【正炁】之所以采集艰难，乃是因为肉眼不可见，炁中孕有一丝道韵，炁中含意……”
“如前身所想采炼的【时序正炁】，若是成了，可随昼夜四季变幻，调整自身炁性。”
“春日生机勃发，采气亦是勃勃生机，修行之速可大增；夏日炁性刚劲威猛，如猛虎霸道，可驱邪避煞；秋日肃杀，炁性凌厉，善斗法；冬日含霜，炁性如冰，善炼法……”
“比之寻常【清炁】玄妙许多，也正是因此，得炼【正炁】，才可被鉴天教收入内门。”
“我所炼之朝煌真炁，虽无四季变幻，但乃是太阳之属，可凝大日真火，且只要朝阳一升，曦光一亮，前夜所受千般之伤，几乎都可复原，凡有迷惘，破晓之时，都得一分悟性转机……”
“恰合我这灵感低下，并非悟性超绝者……”
陆玄精挑细选，最终选择【朝煌真炁】，不仅是因为此炁于他人生经历相符，最合他的心意，大醮最为容易，亦是因为，此炁可以弥补他的短板，在往后的修行之路上，不至于遭受掣肘。
毕竟……炼炁只是修行第二境，往后还有筑基紫府，坐忘金丹等诸般境界。
甚是艰难。
不仅如此，还有修行各般道术的【小醮】，都少不得悟性相助。
“可惜，这古字仅有一次之威……”
陆玄心神沉入炁海，感受着【朝煌真炁】的一缕道韵，心中满意。

可心神流转，落入冥冥空间之中，看着玉碟之上，已然消失的【勤】字，又是忍不住一叹。
玉碟古字，仅有一次之威，所以陆玄选择放在了最重要的【大醮】上，往后没了【勤】字，还需他自己的努力。
“这玉碟古字，到此缘何而出？”
“莫非真是因为我此前行事，勤勉不懈，故而映照而出？”
“还会再有勤字或是其他古字吗？”
陆玄心中沉思。
这些日子，他心神都落在【大醮】之上，故而在知晓【勤】字何用之后，他暂时就并未思索玉碟古字的来源，但此刻【大醮】完成，玉碟之事，立刻就浮上心头了。
此前，他对【勤】字的来历，已经有了些许猜测。
自身勤勉？还是只有勤勉可以补拙？
“咦？”
就在陆玄思索之时，玉碟之上，青光流动，隐约之间，又有一字浮现。
只是相比此前的【勤】字，此字极为模糊，像是墨水不足，难以映刻在玉碟之上。
但心神竭力辨认，陆玄还是勉力认出了此字。
“锐？”
但这一次，许是因为此字太过模糊，陆玄心神沉入玉碟之中，并未得知此字的能力。
同时也并不知晓，如何才能让此字彻底成型，映照玉碟之中。
“锐字何解？”
content_en:
Lu Xuan did not rush out of the Yunting Pavilion to test his ability to fly in the clouds and mist. Instead, he calmed down and felt the sea of ​​​​Qi.
The great ceremony he experienced was so difficult that it required extraordinary energy, but correspondingly, it also had mysterious abilities.
"The turbid air is generated in dirty places and is visible to the naked eye. It can be collected by setting up an altar at will and praying for the power of the earth."
"Za Qi is a little more difficult, but as long as you can find the place where Ling Qi meets, it's easy."
"Qing Qi is the beginning of true practice. Qi is clear and pure, and it can be used to guide the whole body. Afterwards, there will be no obstacles to the practice of Qi, and it will be a little bit magical."
"Like [Song Jian Qi], the ability to control the wind is better than that of ordinary monks, and the whole body has its own rosin..."
"[Jianliu Qi] is slightly stronger at controlling water. You can condense Qi into water without any magic..."
"But in the final analysis, it is still the energy visible to the naked eye, just a little bit of the spirit of nature."
"But [Zheng Qi] is difficult to collect because it is invisible to the naked eye. There is a trace of Taoism in Qi, and Qi contains meaning..."
"If the [Time Sequence Zhengqi] that the predecessor wanted to cultivate is completed, it can adjust its own Qi nature according to the changes in the four seasons of day and night."
"Spring is full of vitality, and Qi collection is also full of vitality, which can greatly increase the speed of practice; summer Qi nature is strong and powerful, like a domineering tiger, which can drive away evil spirits and avoid evil; autumn is chilly, Qi nature is sharp, and it is good at fighting; winter is frosty, and Qi nature is like ice, and it is good at practicing Dharma..."
"It is much more mysterious than the ordinary [Qing Qi]. It is precisely for this reason that you have to refine [Zheng Qi] before you can be accepted into the inner sect of the Jiantian Sect."
"Although the Chaohuang True Qi that I have refined does not change with the seasons, it is an attribute of the sun and can condense the true fire of the great sun. As long as the morning sun rises and the twilight shines, almost all the injuries suffered the night before can be recovered. Anyone who is confused will have a change of understanding at dawn..."
"It's just right for me, who has low inspiration and is not a person with extraordinary understanding..."
Lu Xuan carefully selected, and finally chose [Chaohuang True Qi], not only because this Qi was consistent with his life experience, best suited to his wishes, and the Dajiao was the easiest, but also because this Qi could make up for his shortcomings, so that he would not be hindered in his future practice.
After all... Refining Qi is only the second level of cultivation. In the future, there will be other levels such as Building the Purple Mansion, Sitting and Forgetting the Golden Pill.
Very difficult.
Not only that, but there are also [Xiaojiu] who practice various Taoist arts, all of which need the help of understanding.
"It's a pity that this ancient character only has its power once..."
Lu Xuan's mind sank into the sea of qi, feeling the ray of Taoist charm of [Chaohuang Zhenqi], and felt satisfied in his heart.
But his mind wandered, and he fell into the dark space. Looking at the word "Qin" that had disappeared on the jade plate, he couldn't help but sigh.
The ancient character "Jade Disk" can only be used once, so Lu Xuan chose to put it on the most important "Big Jiao". In the future, if the word "Qin" does not exist, he will still need his own efforts.
"Why did this ancient Chinese character Jade Disk come from here?"
"Is it really because of my diligence and diligence in my previous actions that it reflects on me?"
"Will there be any more Qin or other ancient characters?"
Lu Xuan pondered in his heart.
These days, his mind has been focused on the [Big Jiao], so after knowing the purpose of the word [Qin], he has not thought about the origin of the ancient word Jade Disc for the time being. But now that the [Big Jiao] is completed, the matter of the Jade Disc immediately comes to mind.
Previously, he had some guesses about the origin of the word "Qin".
Diligent yourself? Or can only diligence make up for clumsiness?
"Huh?"
Just as Lu Xuan was thinking, green light flowed on the jade plate, and another word appeared vaguely.
But compared to the previous word "Qin", this word is extremely blurry, as if there is not enough ink to be engraved on the jade plate.
But he tried his best to identify it, and Lu Xuan still managed to recognize the word.
"Rui?"
But this time, perhaps because the word was too vague, Lu Xuan's mind sank into the jade plate and he did not know the power of this word.
At the same time, I don’t know how toLet this word take complete shape and reflect in the jade dish.
"What do you mean by sharp?"
